description: TEST-ONLY Ed25519 recovery keys, committed on purpose (named by the *.test-key.json convention, conformance layout section 1.3). Never enroll one of them anywhere but a test. Each key is a 32-byte RFC 8032 seed (the private key) and its raw 32-byte public key, both as lowercase hexadecimal. recovery signs the signature fixture's challenge: its seed is SHA-256 of the ASCII text "skyoauth recovery.test-key.json recovery"; other is a second key, its seed SHA-256 of "skyoauth recovery.test-key.json other"; rfc8032_test1 is RFC 8032 section 7.1, test 1, whose public key is the new recovery key of the challenge fixture's op_1 plan. Readers: operator/tests/operator.rs (the workstation's SoftwareSigner) and tests/harness/recovery_signature_fixture.rs (ed25519-dalek's SigningKey, and the service's bootstrap_instance with the recovery key).
